A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. All 16 pages in each version, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–C, support reliable comparison through text extraction and rendered-page inspection.

before.justification: v1 reports original marker-confidence evaluations across seven LLMs and seven main QA datasets, threshold robustness experiments, and additional distribution analyses (Tables 1–2 and Appendix C).

after.justification: v2 reports original marker-confidence evaluations and robustness results, including Table 1's multi-model experiments and Appendix C's MATH-500/GSM8K comparison.

M1.justification: Marker-confidence computation, response prompting, and marker-extraction procedures are unchanged (Section 3 and Appendix B). No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Both retain BoolQ, StrategyQA, GSM8K, MMLU, CSQA, MedMCQA, and CaseHOLD, together with Appendix C's MATH-500/GSM8K difficulty comparison. No dataset or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Direct numerical-confidence elicitation remains the baseline in Table 1. The base versus instruction-tuned model comparisons in Figure 4 also retain the same participants.

E3.justification: The dataset splits and preprocessing, temperature of 0.5, model configurations, seven evaluation metrics, prompting procedures, and marker-frequency thresholds are unchanged (Section 4 and Appendix B).

E4.justification: Both retain identical threshold sensitivity tests, model-performance correlations, prompt-variation checks, base/instruction-tuned analyses, and distribution-diversity and difficulty analyses (Sections 4.2–4.3, Appendix B.1, and Appendix C).

E5.justification: Table 6 retains the same approximate confidence intervals for occurrence thresholds 10, 50, and 200. Run/seed information and statistical reporting are unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative results are unchanged, including the appendix results. For example, Table 8 retains MRC values of 0.38 for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 0.26 for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3.

T1.justification: The marker-confidence definition and metric formulations in Section 3 and Appendix B.4 are unchanged. The spelling correction in the MAC description does not alter its mathematical meaning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: relatively stable in-distribution marker confidence, poor cross-distribution consistency, and difficulties maintaining distinct confidence levels and marker rankings.

C2.justification: The distribution-preference interpretation in Section 4.4 and Appendix C is unchanged. Both retain the same limitations concerning brief English QA responses, sentence structure, long-form communication, and cultural or linguistic variation.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains identical prompts, model identifiers, preprocessing instructions, and hardware/precision details. The code-access link and licensing disclosures are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including Appendix A's distinction between studying models' internal marker consistency and aligning marker interpretations with human judgments.

P1.justification: Section 3.2 corrects 'propotional' to 'proportional', and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. The remaining wording and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 italicizes most model names and becomes slightly wider with adjusted column spacing. Section 3.2 completes the italic formatting of 'Numerical ECE'. Figures, table contents, captions, and placement remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 makes a spelling correction and small typographic/layout adjustments. The scientific content, empirical evidence, appendices, limitations, and reproducibility information are unchanged, so these cosmetic edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
